build_CalibratedClassifierCV: build a calibrated classifier using isotonic, sigmoid, or temperature scaling with cross-validation
create_calibration_curve: create a calibration curve by computing true and predicted probabilities for a binary classifier
plot_CalibrationDisplay: plot a calibration curve visualization (reliability diagram) for a fitted binary classifier
fit_temperature_scaling: fit temperature scaling to calibrate predicted probabilities using softmax with optimized temperature
calibrate_sigmoid_regression: calibrate classifier probabilities using sigmoid (Platt) regression with Bayesian priors
